text.tspan: AWS Snowball: move data physically, or compute at the edge
Status (AWS docs, 2026): Snowball Edge closed to NEW customers on 7 Nov 2025 (existing customers keep using it).
Snowcone discontinued 12 Nov 2024 · Snowmobile (100 PB truck) retired in 2024.
Alternatives: DataSync (online), Data Transfer Terminal (bring your own disks), Outposts (edge compute).
Time to transfer over the network (course)
Rule of thumb: more than a WEEK over the network
Snowball = highly secure, portable device to collect and
process data at the edge and migrate data INTO and OUT of AWS
(up to petabytes; 16-node cluster up to 2.6 PB).
Process data where it is created: truck, ship, mine underground
(limited internet, no compute). Run EC2 instances or Lambda
(IoT Greengrass) on the device. Use: preprocess, ML, transcode.
